scientific_integrity: Full all-size bijective argument supplied, using the preexisting one-preference enumerator; computational tests are finite corroboration, not an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The joint law is for preference values 1 and 2 under uniform classical parking functions, not arbitrary preference values or alternative parking rules; priority relative to general multivariate parking enumerators is not independently established.
title: Joint leading-preference occupancy in uniform parking functions
